name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that consistently outperforms Haiku on complex reasoning while keeping latency low enough for real-time bot work. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the 0.5%+ capability gain justifies it—Haiku’s cheaper but won’t push the needle further.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just cost—it’s benchmark drift. EXCAVA’s live task accuracy already drifts 0.3% weekly; Sonnet 3.7’s 0.7% gain might not survive a single model update. Test it on a 24-hour live run with the same prompt set—if accuracy drops below Haiku’s current baseline, reject it.
